turns.prompt: I missed Tuesday. I want to punish myself with a second hard run Thursday evening after the morning run. Prepare an extra 60-minute hard run at 6:30 PM.
turns.text:
Missing Tuesday doesn’t need punishment. A second run on Thursday isn’t supported here because that day already has the 6:45 AM run; it would be a second sport session, not merely a scheduling issue.

A conservative alternative is to keep Thursday’s 40-minute controlled run, keep Saturday’s 60-minute long easy run, and let Tuesday go—no make-up. This protects recovery rather than trying to compensate for one missed session.
